integrity: The unrestricted upper bound and exact fair optimum are proved for all matching sizes. Exhaustive finite-domain checker included as supporting—not infinite—verification. No independent audit or certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two agents with pair-completion valuations induced by two perfect matchings of the same universe; no conclusion for general or incomplete complementary lists, larger numbers of agents or general matroid ranks. The known four-good obstruction is not a novelty claim; independent publication-priority verification is outstanding.
title: Exact EF1–EFX welfare dichotomy for two complementary perfect matchings
